Hi Marc —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I'm sending the consolidated invoice for June (attached) — we aggregated the two smaller invoices into a single remittance to simplify your AP batch. Quick notes and requests so we can close this out by the 22nd: 

- Invoice: Invoice_JUNE-2026_LUMENIX.pdf (total $48,720).
- Preferred payment: ACH is our preferred route; I attached an ACH authorization form for your processor.
- If ACH isn't possible on your end, we can accept a split payment (ACH + wire) — please confirm the split you prefer.
- VAT question: I know you mentioned a UK/EU subsidiary — if Lumenix intends to reverse-charge VAT, please confirm the EU entity name and VAT ID so we can annotate the invoice.

Could you confirm: 1) AP timeline (expected payment date), 2) remit account for ACH (or if you need a wire), and 3) whether you need a W9 (attached if helpful).

If useful, we can also push a one-time card fallback via our payments partner to avoid delays; we'd need AP's sign-off for that.

Thanks —

Thanks, Jasmine — appreciate the consolidation. A couple quick answers and asks: 

- AP timing: We run supplier payments on the 20th and 27th of the month; earliest we can remit is the 20th, most likely the 27th.
- Remit: We prefer ACH — I'll need your routing/account details or a printable ACH form. AP copied here (ap@lumenix.health) — hi team, can you confirm any blocklist rules for new payees?
- Split: If cashflow demands it, we could do 60% ACH (20th) and 40% wire (27th). Can you accept that?
- VAT: Lumenix EU is Lumenix Health Europe Ltd, VAT GB999888777 — we plan to reverse-charge on services where applicable. Please advise how Redwood wants that annotated.
- Docs: Please send your W9 and the ACH authorization. Also, do you have a DUNS or vendor code we should use?

If AP confirms, we'll mark the invoice as pending/partial and watch for the ACH settlement on the 20th. Let me know if you prefer a slightly different split.
